UPSTREAM: r8152: move calling r8153b_rx_agg_chg_indicate() r8153b_rx_agg_chg_indicate() needs to be called after enabling TX/RX and before calling rxdy_gated_en(tp, false). Otherwise, the change of the settings of RX aggregation wouldn't work. Besides, adjust rtl8152_set_coalesce() for the same reason. If rx_coalesce_usecs is changed, restart TX/RX to let the setting work. Signed-off-by: Hayes Wang <hayeswang@realtek.com> Signed-off-by: David S. UPSTREAM: r8152: set RTL8152_UNPLUG only for real disconnection Set the flag of RTL8152_UNPLUG if and only if the device is unplugged. Some error codes sometimes don't mean the real disconnection of usb device. For those situations, set the flag of RTL8152_UNPLUG causes the driver skips some flows of disabling the device, and it let the device stay at incorrect state. pd_faft: In PDVbusRequest test, the expected voltage should not exceed DUT limit In firmware_PDVbusRequest test, it changes servo v4 to source different voltages, the DUT reacts and selects the highest one it supports. So the expected result should not exceed the DUT input voltage limit. For example, when the test asks servo v4 to source 20V, but DUT only supports 12V max. The expected result should be 12V, instead of 20V. BUG=b:139372561 TEST=Ran firmware_PDVbusRequest on Ampton, which supports 15V max. modemfwd: migrate to generalized MOCK_METHOD() macro This CL replaces the uses of MOCK_METHOD*() and MOCK_CONST_METHOD*() macros in unit tests with the generalized MOCK_METHOD() macro, which is now the recommended way to define mocked methods with gmock. In particular, MOCK_METHOD() supports annotating a mocked method with specifiers such as 'override'. BUG=None TEST=Run unit tests.
